---
title: "Blog"
subtitle: "Notes on Quarto, R Markdown, and working with AI agents."
listing:
  # Feed only: lists every post for index.xml and renders nothing on the page.
  # It has no id on purpose: q2 names the feed after the listing id
  # (index-<id>.xml), and the navbar links index.xml.
  - contents: posts
    type: custom
    template: !str /_extensions/cderv/ghostwriter/feed.template
    feed: true
    sort: "date desc"
  - id: posts-2022
    contents: "posts/2022-*/index.qmd"
    type: default
    fields: [title, date, categories]
    date-format: "ddd, MMM D, YYYY"
    categories: true
    sort: "date desc"
  - id: posts-2021
    contents: "posts/2021-*/index.qmd"
    type: default
    fields: [title, date, categories]
    date-format: "ddd, MMM D, YYYY"
    categories: true
    sort: "date desc"
  - id: posts-2018
    contents: "posts/2018-*/index.qmd"
    type: default
    fields: [title, date, categories]
    date-format: "ddd, MMM D, YYYY"
    categories: true
    sort: "date desc"
  - id: posts-2016
    contents: "posts/2016-*/index.qmd"
    type: default
    fields: [title, date, categories]
    date-format: "ddd, MMM D, YYYY"
    categories: true
    sort: "date desc"
---

Posts are grouped by year, like talks.qmd. A new post goes in

section when the post is published.
